response.sql: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS baseline_avg FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_group_average, AVG(t.avg_ownership - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM timing_averages AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_ownership > b.baseline_avg;
